notes.title: Lust For Speed in Early Acccess!
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644311/38ab05f9ec6b8f17a30d7f894d6ae09a94ecdaa1.png"][/img]

[h3]Hey everyone!
I’m beyond excited to finally announce that the game is launching in Early Access!

I’m literally shaking from excitement and fear.[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1535110/Lust_for_Speed/

[h3]
This game has been through development hell, fought off all the demons there, and somehow made it out alive — straight into Early Access!

Just a reminder: this is a dating sim with street racing, where you grab a badass ride, tune it to the max, and crush some hot Racer-Ladies — and if you charm them well enough, you might even Fuck em!
[/h3]

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644311/379a537a31a014edabec8ae2a605ae39bafbd8c8.jpg"][/img]

[h3]You can even add your own custom vinyls to your ride!
[olist]
[*] Right-click the game in your Steam Library → Manage → Browse local files
[*] Open the folder [b]LustForSpeed_EA_Data[/b]
[*] Inside it, find the [b]UserVinyls[/b] folder
[*] Drop your images there!
[*] In-game, create a new vinyl and open the [b]“User”[/b] category
[*] Make it White
[/olist]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40644311/59461d3fbab33522689c302309f4e1b78efea0d8.jpg"][/img]

[h3]If you want your unique vinyl to be added into the game — feel free to send it to me, for example at afftarmudac@gmail.com

The image should be PNG with transparency.
It can be fully white (for coloring in-game) 
Or already colored.
No partial transparency — the engine will Clip it as fully transparent.

That’s all for now!
Looking forward to your feedback, bug reports, suggestions, reviews and ideas — all in the Steam Community section!

See you there!
[/h3]

tags.feature: You can even add your own custom vinyls to your ride!

[olist]
[*] Go to your Steam client

[*] Select the "SET LAUNCH OPTIONS"
[*] Type in "noshadows" in the input field and press "OK"
